name: @dsh-companion/bridge
description: dsh-companion 电脑端：DeepSeek Harness 桥接插件（mobile/v1 协议服务端）+ dshc Worker CLI

scripts.build: esbuild src/plugin/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@deepseek-ai/* --external:ws --outfile=dist/plugin/index.js && esbuild src/cli/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:@deepseek-ai/* --external:ws --external:qrcode-terminal --outfile=dist/cli/index.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/cli/index.js';fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+fs.readFileSync(f))"
